ratios.covenant_name: maximum consolidated total net leverage ratio
ratios.quote: Under the Credit Agreement, the Company is required to maintain a maximum consolidated total net leverage ratio, as defined in the Credit Agreement, of (i) 5.00 x for the fiscal quarter ended July 3, 2026 and (ii) 4.75 x for the fiscal quarter ending October 2, 2026 and (iii) 4.50 x for the first fiscal quarter of fiscal 2027 and each fiscal quarter thereafter through maturity.
the Credit Agreement also established a minimum interest coverage ratio, as defined in the Credit Agreement, of at least 2.00 x for the term of the Credit Agreement.

parsed.notes: Filing states only covenant requirements and that the Company was in compliance with all covenants as of July 3, 2026; actual ratios not disclosed. Leverage covenant steps down to 4.75x for quarter ending Oct 2, 2026 and 4.50x from Q1 fiscal 2027. The 4.50x dividend/repurchase restriction threshold and the 3.30x pricing step-down are not separate covenants and are excluded. A $15M bad debt add-back to EBITDA applied for covenant purposes in quarter ended March 28, 2025.
